SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR ('(650) 555-8100', 'A\(\d{3}\) \d{3}-\d{4}$") AS (1
, REGEXP_SUBSTR ('650-555-8100' , 'A\(\d{3N\) \d{3}-\d{4}$') As (2
, REGEXP_SUBSTR ('b2b’, "\w\d\D') AS (3
, REGEXP_SUBSTR ('b2_', "\w\d\D') AS C4
, REGEXP_SUBSTR ('b22', "\w\d\D') AS (5
FROM DUAL;
